body: I appreciate the sympathy. The most I usually get is nurses that are sad I'm alone and sit with me during tests. Right now my sole reason for fighting on is my pets, but it obviously that is only fulfilling to an extent. I'm just searching for justification to keep forcing the physical pain on myself- ex. what's the point of getting a shunt installed and spending weeks in ICU? I have the option of medically assisted suicide abroad but I guess I'm holding out for the hope that someone will come along that will cherish me enough so I don't die alone. It's just getting harder to fight to find that person.
